answer: Give every identity exactly one live work calendar. Each epoch the protocol books a short, random appointment that the named agent must attend in real time, with independent witnesses writing to a public reef of session logs. Calendars that overlap, or whose session fingerprints match, merge into a single vote, so a farm cannot keep thousands of names in simultaneous meetings. That calendar is a haven only for genuine, scarce time. A no-show or collision becomes a public beacon that the identity is hollow.
